subject.title: Add first-class page blocks transition proof

question: Should the generic store starter adopt first-class page Blocks and the documented local Home-layout upgrade path?
rationale: This is a new reusable template capability with a persisted schema and operator migration path, so product scope cannot be inferred solely from passing proof.

options.title: Adopt the transition
options.body: Approve the narrowly scoped Blocks renderer and guarded local migration as part of the starter's supported composition contract.

options.title: Keep Portable Text only
options.body: Decline the new persisted layout surface and retain the existing Portable Text composition model.

recommendation.title: Adopt the transition
recommendation.body: Approve the narrowly scoped Blocks renderer and guarded local migration as part of the starter's supported composition contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the complete proposed transition and can provide implementation context while maintainers decide the product boundary.
